purpose: Fresh public auction/building training roots with exact uninstrumented twin controls; no labels or gradients. All decisions selected before outcomes.

model.selection: Fixed10102 used throughout phase diagnostics; not a new model selected from these games.

root_selection: Every target-seat multi-choice ChoosePowerPlant/Bid/Build observation; no terminal-result, win/loss, final-round or future-action filtering.
split: Whole count/mode/deal units; all seats, rule combinations and repeated roots stay together. Training/evaluation/final seed prefixes disjoint.
sampling_policy: Exact serial float64 ONNX policy. snapshot0 opponents use the same pinned policy, giving frozen self-play with one designated observer. search_geo remains16 samples,6 proposals,2400-step search cap. Learner search disabled.
independent_neural_reference: A260 is excluded from this collection and remains a development evaluation reference.
controls: Every collected game has an uninstrumented twin. Compare every model observation, submitted action and terminal row exactly. Actual game cap1600; every search cap counted.
outputs: Every public root, exact legal menu, model proposal, game/decision ordinal and split.
All terminal rows for completion/coverage only; not teacher targets.
Exact twin comparison hashes and engine/inference timing.
follow_up: Freeze a separate paired-continuation teacher protocol after collection coverage/runtime; preserve uncertainty and do not equate these positions or labels with strength.
